name: Clay
tagline: GTM data platform with an AI research agent (Claygent), enrich, research and personalise outbound at scale.
verdict: Clay has become the GTM data layer serious outbound teams build on, and for good reason: its waterfall enrichment posts materially higher match rates than any single-source tool, and Claygent adds AI research that scrapes the web for data points no provider packages. Put together with signals, scoring, AI copy, a sequencer and ad-audience sync, it takes you from raw list to CRM-ready outbound in one workspace, with unlimited seats on every plan. The tradeoffs are equally well documented: the dual credit meter is genuinely hard to predict, failed lookups still cost credits and Claygent-heavy runs can balloon at scale, and the tool has a steep enough learning curve that it really wants a dedicated GTM engineer. Pick Clay if you have the technical appetite and a budget above a few hundred dollars a month; skip it if you need predictable flat pricing or have no one to build the workflows.
